g.text:
INCOMPLETE / DO NOT INTEGRATE: power-drive and current path drafted only.
OPEN: VDRV12 regulator+bootstrap; U9001 VCCUV/OVLO/TG wiring; 
FAN_CMD AND PWM gate; OCP comparator threshold/pull-up + latch; TVS/input protection; footprints; validation.
No hardware/fire test. 50V transient ceiling is an assumption, not implemented.

g.desc:
INCOMPLETE / DO NOT INTEGRATE: power-drive and current path drafted only.
OPEN: VDRV12 regulator+bootstrap; U9001 VCCUV/OVLO/TG wiring; 
FAN_CMD AND PWM gate; OCP comparator threshold/pull-up + latch; TVS/input protection; footprints; validation.
No hardware/fire test. 50V transient ceiling is an assumption, not implemented.

g.text: PWM RELEASE GATE: firmware 1…78125 Hz / 1…1000 permille is NOT qualified by this schematic. Qg,max=210nC makes gate-charge demand 4.20mA @20kHz and 16.406mA @78125Hz; exact driver output-current, bootstrap recharge impedance, switching loss and thermal limits require bench capture before any dynamic-PWM maximum is released. Static OFF/ON is the only pre-bench permitted state.

g.desc: PWM RELEASE GATE: firmware 1…78125 Hz / 1…1000 permille is NOT qualified by this schematic. Qg,max=210nC makes gate-charge demand 4.20mA @20kHz and 16.406mA @78125Hz; exact driver output-current, bootstrap recharge impedance, switching loss and thermal limits require bench capture before any dynamic-PWM maximum is released. Static OFF/ON is the only pre-bench permitted state.

g.text: POWER/TRANSIENT: LM317HV IN-OUT 60V abs-max with 30% margin requires VIN clamp <=46.154V during an output short. No input TVS is fitted: transient qualification remains OPEN. D9002 MBR1100G (100V) is A=VDRV12V/K=BST and has 2.17x voltage margin to that conservative clamp ceiling. D9001 STPS30H100CW: both anodes=MOTOR_POS, common cathode=GND.

g.desc: POWER/TRANSIENT: LM317HV IN-OUT 60V abs-max with 30% margin requires VIN clamp <=46.154V during an output short. No input TVS is fitted: transient qualification remains OPEN. D9002 MBR1100G (100V) is A=VDRV12V/K=BST and has 2.17x voltage margin to that conservative clamp ceiling. D9001 STPS30H100CW: both anodes=MOTOR_POS, common cathode=GND.
